YOUR GOAL IS OUR MISSION

The unique architecture of R.S NESS Group merges operational compliance and regulatory guidelines with innovative solutions and advanced technology. This allows our clients to navigate and overcome intricate business challenges in these industries.

We specialize in End-to-End solutions and tailor our service offerings according to the client’s requirement in the following areas: Product Engineering, Validations, Audits, Clinical Affairs, Engineering project management, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs.

SUCCESS STORIES

"Dear RS-NESS team, You entered our lives during a very stressful period of moving to a new facility, Validations and very tight schedules. Your commitment to the mission was maximum, demonstrating professionalism and not less important - providing a pleasant and sociable atmosphere. You never hesitated to lend a shoulder so that we meet the goals and tasks with maximum quality. Over time, you became an integral part of the team. On this occasion we wanted to thank you for all of your support. Well Done!"
Esther AbramovQuality Assurance Manager - BiondVax Pharmacueticals
"CME, produces Medical Devices (Infusion pumps, Syringe Pumps and Infusion Sets), was acquired 3 years ago by BD. We have found your company, RS-NESS, as the most qualified to support with the integration as well as with establishing and improving our foundations of the quality, engineering and validation areas. At the end of three years of integration, I can wholeheartedly say that your company meets and even exceeded our expectations. Beyond the high quality of work and meeting timelines you have been proving yourselves as loyal partners. I want to take that opportunity to thank you and your team for everything you have been doing in the last 3 years – well done!"
Idan LaiferCEO in CME-BD
